set.body:
Problem: receipts do not name what was actually done. Modulator center = "run" maps to Centering.Global (EventModelBuilder.scala:3011); centring is in fact within-run because prepare runs once per run (:2448-2454), but the receipt prints center=Global (:2466), which is misleading provenance. SamplingFrame.startTime defaults to TR/2 (SamplingFrame.scala:125) and no named sampling reference appears in receipts or labels; SPM microtime T exists only for spm-1s (TemporalDerivativeConvention.scala:60).

Consumer need: studio labels must state the math correctly (spec invariant I8; G18).

Acceptance:
- Centring receipts state the requested scope (run, cell, none) and the actual grouping.
- Build receipts name the sampling reference (e.g. mid-volume, slice-time reference) and its value.
- JVM+JS tests assert the receipt text.

Out of scope: changing defaults.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Receipts name the centring scope and the sampling reference
